publisher.description: the person or organisation that publishes the newsletter, as the publisher names itself

homepage.description: the publisher's own page for the newsletter

feed_url.description: the public RSS or Atom feed the publisher advertises; the job matches this address to its source entry

cadence.description: how often the publisher says it publishes; absent when the publisher does not say

language.description: language of the issues, as an ISO 639-1 code
